instructions.run_date: run.py asks for COB in DD/MM/YYYY. COB must be yesterday or earlier in Europe/London.
instructions.history: run.py asks for the history start (DD/MM/YYYY). HISTORY_START and COB are resolved into actual dates for every non-option request. Range errors trigger provider-specific maximum accessible history; fallback and limitations are recorded. Authentication/network errors do not trigger date fallbacks.
instructions.archive: A completed tests/data_dumps/YYYY-MM-DD archive is reused without API calls. Interrupted runs resume unfinished requests.
instructions.products: SPX index, SPY equity ETF and IEF Treasury ETF where supported; existing FRED/ECB reference series retained.
instructions.options: Only IBKR requests options: yesterday COB selects current live snapshots; older COB selects historical bars only. Live capture dates remain separate from COB.

index.instructions: SPX is the S&P 500 price index. Use the provider-native identifier and check enabled/notes in requests for current access. No SPY substitution.
